from pathlib import Path
import ast,datetime,glob,hashlib,json,re,subprocess,time
from multisport_lab.integrity import IntegrityError,write_receipt,stamp
from multisport_lab.pros004_producer import make_source_binding,validate_source_binding
root=Path('/workspace/nml-pros004-readiness');pin='71329d184f3857c9e75ee6cf12bbe841c6e4cccb'
revision=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip()
binding=make_source_binding(pin,root=root)
output=root/'evidence/verification/pros004-software-checks-v3.json'
if output.exists():raise IntegrityError('Keep earlier software evidence')
commands=[('python',['python3','-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-v']),
 ('optimized',['python3','-O','-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-p','test_pros004*.py','-v']),
 ('frontend',['node','--test','--test-isolation=none',*sorted(glob.glob('web/tests/*.test.mjs'))]),
 ('demo',['python3','-m','multisport_lab.demo']),
 ('build',['python3','-m','multisport_lab.publication','--build-commit',revision]),
 ('artifact',['node','web/tests/site-smoke.mjs','output']),
 ('browser',['python3','-O','web/tests/pros004_browser_smoke.py'])]
results=[]
for name,args in commands:
 started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc);timer=time.perf_counter()
 logfile=Path('/tmp/nml-pros004-'+name+'-v3.log')
 if logfile.exists():raise IntegrityError('Preserve earlier check log')
 with logfile.open('xb') as stream:r=subprocess.run(args,cwd=root,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=False)
 raw=logfile.read_bytes();message=raw.decode(errors='replace')
 match=re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests in ([0-9.]+)s',message)
 result={'name':name,'argv':args,'started_at':stamp(started),'completed_at':stamp(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)),
 'wall_seconds':time.perf_counter()-timer,'exit_code':r.returncode,'log_path':str(logfile),
 'log_bytes':len(raw),'log_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'result_tail':message.splitlines()[-12:]}
 if match:result.update(tests=int(match.group(1)),unittest_seconds=float(match.group(2)))
 results.append(result);print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
 if r.returncode:break
paths=[*root.glob('multisport_lab/pros004*.py'),root/'scripts/verify_pros004_readiness.py',root/'web/tests/pros004_browser_smoke.py']
assertions={str(p.relative_to(root)):sum(isinstance(n,ast.Assert) for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(p.read_bytes()))) for p in paths}
if any(assertions.values()):raise IntegrityError('New verifier code contains disappearing assertions')
validate_source_binding(binding,check_current=True)
report={'schema_version':'nba-pros004-software-verification-v3','recorded_at':stamp(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)),
 'producer_source_commit':pin,'test_revision':revision,'producer_binding':binding,'evidence_lane':'SOFTWARE_SYNTHETIC_ONLY',
 'results':results,'new_code_assert_nodes':assertions,'status':'PASS' if len(results)==len(commands) and all(x['exit_code']==0 for x in results) else 'FAILED',
 'genuine_issuance':0,'reserved_comparative_evaluation':0,'activation':False,'deployment':False,
 'harness_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'harness':Path(__file__).read_text(),
 'earlier_attempts_preserved':['evidence/verification/pros004-software-checks-v2.json'],
 'scope':'Subprocess tests and temporary local artifact; browser fixture is explicitly synthetic. No provider capture or public deployment.'}
write_receipt(output,report,max_bytes=1024*1024)
if report['status']!='PASS':raise IntegrityError('A software check failed; inspect retained evidence')
